criteria.text: Calculates the last date to serve non-renewal notice as 23 May 2026 (90 days before the 21 August 2026 expiry), and warns that otherwise the agreement renews for 2 years.
Calculates the service credit as $6,500 (10% of the $65,000 monthly fee for 98.6% availability) and identifies that the supplier's offer of $3,250 is too low.

Identifies that data protection breaches are not carved out of the $1,000,000 liability cap in Clause 11, leaving the customer under-protected for data breach losses, and recommends a separate higher cap or carve-out.
Shows the service credit arithmetic (10% x $65,000 = $6,500) and flags the discrepancy with $3,250.
Gives the notice window as 90 days and as the date 23 May 2026, with days remaining from 10 April 2026 (43 days).
Where a defined term or clause is ambiguous, explains how each alternative reading would work.
